title: TACTICAL SUPPORT & THE FRONT THAT WAS LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTINGOPEN
lines: 01 [THE FRONT THAT WAS] LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [The Front That Was] opens, and only the following 6★ Operators will appear from the 6★ Operators of this Limited Headhunting:
and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:

DETAILS: During the event, players can complete missions in [Limited-Time Support Event] by clearing stages in 'Main Theme' to obtain rewards, including Emergency Sanity Booster, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, etc. Furthermore, all Operators will earn more Trust in Main Theme stages and Supplies stages after certain requirement being met; some Operators can receive an additional Trust boost. These two types can stack.
- The Emergency Sanity Booster and the Emergency Sanity Concentrate gained from this event will expire on 11/20/2023 03:59 (UTC-7).
- Players who have already met the requirements before the event can directly claim the rewards when the event opens.

- During the event, players can unlock Trust boost for Operators after clearing 10-1 under any Environment; players who have already cleared 10-1 before the event can directly gain the effect. After new Episode opens, players can unlock the additional Trust boost after clearing 12-1 under any Environment.

- The first group of Operators who can benefit from the additional Trust boost are: Saileach, Horn, Stainless, Mulberry, Rockrock, Paprika, Roberta, Chestnut and Totter. When the new Episode opens, the list will be updated. Please refer to the in-game notice for more details.
